Describe and move coherent application capabilities as packages rather than reproducing configuration and content by hand in every environment.

Why Packaging belongs in the platform

Repeatable systems need a repeatable way to carry definitions between applications and environments. cCoder.Packaging gives that movement an explicit domain model, making imports inspectable and allowing participating domains to handle package content through their own boundaries.

What consumers gain

  • Package definitions and importable application payloads.
  • A shared contract for domain-specific package participation.
  • Metadata and tested integration with the wider platform.

A boundary that keeps paying for itself

Packaging coordinates portable definitions; it does not take ownership of the content, workflow or security records inside them. Each domain remains responsible for validating and applying its own portion.

Adopt the capability, not its internal complexity

Add the package at the application composition boundary, configure the providers or infrastructure it requires and consume its service contracts through dependency injection. The package keeps its implementation and operational concerns together, while the consuming code remains focused on its own business purpose.
